concepts.title: Piecewise affine homeomorphism on a planar domain
concepts.description: A homeomorphism on an open subset of ℝ² that is affine on every triangle of a locally finite triangulation; the triangulation need not be finite.

concepts.title: Mora-Corral–Pratelli smoothing of planar piecewise affine homeomorphisms
concepts.description: A planar piecewise affine homeomorphism in W¹,¹ can be approximated arbitrarily closely, both uniformly and in W¹,¹, by smooth diffeomorphisms, preserving boundary values when the continuous boundary extension is prescribed.

concepts.title: Poisson kernel of the unit disk
concepts.description: For ζ on the unit circle and z in the disk, Pζ(z)=(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²; integrating it against boundary data gives harmonic extensions.

concepts.title: Poisson representation of positive harmonic functions on the disk
concepts.description: Every nonnegative harmonic function h on the unit disk is uniquely h(z)=∫_T(1−|z|²)/|ζ−z|²dμ(ζ) for a finite positive Borel measure μ on the unit circle.

concepts.title: Polar coordinates in the Euclidean plane
concepts.description: A point is written (r cosθ,r sinθ) with r≥0; away from zero, r>0 and the angle is understood modulo2π.

concepts.title: Division algorithm for polynomials over a field
concepts.description: For polynomials a,b over a field with b≠0, there are unique polynomials q,r with a=bq+r and either r=0 or deg r<deg b.

concepts.title: Polynomial over a field
concepts.description: A formal finite sum a₀+a₁x+⋯+aₙxⁿ with coefficients in a field, with the usual coefficientwise addition and multiplication.

concepts.title: Approximation of a convex body by polytopes
concepts.description: Every Euclidean convex body is a Hausdorff limit of convex hulls of finite point sets.

concepts.title: Norm closedness of the positive cone of a C*-algebra
concepts.description: A norm limit of positive elements of a C*-algebra is positive.

concepts.title: Positive definite complex kernel
concepts.description: A kernel K:X×X→ℂ is positive definite if ∑ᵢⱼcᵢc̄ⱼK(xᵢ,xⱼ)≥0 for every finite choice of points xᵢ and scalars cᵢ.

concepts.title: Positive distributions are Radon measures
concepts.description: A distribution T satisfying T(φ)≥0 for every nonnegative smooth compactly supported test function is integration against a unique positive Radon measure.

concepts.title: Positive element and order in a C*-algebra
concepts.description: An element is positive if it has the form b*b. For self-adjoint a,b, write a≤b when b−a is positive.

concepts.title: Order-unit bound for a positive C*-algebra element
concepts.description: For positive a in a C*-algebra, a≤∥a∥1 in its unitization.

concepts.title: Positive linear functional on a complex *-algebra
concepts.description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for all a∈A; neither a C*-norm on A nor continuity is assumed.

concepts.title: Positive linear functional on a C*-algebra
concepts.description: A complex linear map φ:A→ℂ satisfying φ(a*a)≥0 for every a∈A.

concepts.title: Bounded positive operator
concepts.description: A bounded self-adjoint operator A is positive, written A≥0, if ⟨Ax,x⟩≥0 for every vector x.

concepts.title: Positive square root in a C*-algebra
concepts.description: Every positive element a of a C*-algebra has a unique positive element b with b²=a. For any a, its absolute value is |a|=(a*a)¹ᐟ².

concepts.title: Probability density relative to a measure
concepts.description: A nonnegative measurable function P with ∫P dμ=1; the measure P dμ is the corresponding probability measure.
